question: What is the complete address of the school with the lowest excellence rate? Indicate the Street, City, Zip and State.
evidence: Execellence Rate = NumGE1500 / NumTstTakr; complete address has Street, City, State, Zip code
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0, c1, c2, c3 FROM (SELECT T2.Street AS c0, T2.City AS c1, T2.State AS c2, T2.Zip AS c3, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(T1.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T1.NumTstTakr ASC) AS __r FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode) AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY CAST(T1.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T1.NumTstTakr ASC LIMIT 1

d.request: What is the complete address (street, city, zip code, and state) of the school with the lowest excellence rate, where excellence rate is calculated as NumGE1500 divided by NumTstTakr, and if multiple schools tie for the lowest excellence rate, return all of them?
d.sql: SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State FROM satscores t JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = t.cds WHERE t.NumTstTakr > 0 AND (CAST(t.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / t.NumTstTakr) = (SELECT MIN(CAST(NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NumTstTakr) FROM satscores WHERE NumTstTakr > 0 AND NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL)

b.request: Find the school with the minimum NumGE1500/NumTstTakr ratio, returning all schools tied at that minimum, and give each one's Street, City, Zip and State from the schools table
b.sql: SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State FROM satscores t JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = t.cds WHERE t.NumTstTakr > 0 AND t.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL AND CAST(t.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / t.NumTstTakr = (SELECT MIN(CAST(NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NumTstTakr) FROM satscores WHERE NumTstTakr > 0 AND NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL)
